reason: D32: the Go port lists only the kept commands; retired commands print one 'retired' line (docs/retired-commands.md)
stdout:
usage: module-nav [-h] [--base-dir DIR] <command> [<args>]

Module Navigator - CLI for Niagara N4 decompiled modules

options:
  -h, --help            show this help message and exit
  --base-dir, -d BASE_DIR
                        Base directory (auto-detected if omitted)

commands (module-nav <command> --help for its options):

  Inventory and self-checks:
    selftest                Self-checks; --recall verifies `class` finds every declaration in organized/
    inventory               Summary of all indexed modules
    module                  Detailed info for a specific submodule
    modules                 List modules with filters
    stats                   Corpus summary (modules, classes, indexes)

  Find classes and concepts:
    class                   Look up a class by exact name
    search                  Search classes by glob pattern
    ask                     Same as `rank` (ranked classes for a question); see also: grep

  Source text, strings and resources:
    grep                    Regex search across all decompiled sources
    rank                    Classes most relevant to a free-text question (EN/ES), best first
    source                  Show info or source code for a class
    resources               List non-Java resources in module JAR
    token                   Exact token search (instant via SQLite index)

  Types: hierarchy, members, imports:
    hierarchy               Show subclass tree or inheritance chain
    implementors            Show classes implementing an interface

  Call and data flow:
    callers                 Who calls this method (or, without one, every method of the class)
    callees                 What methods this class/method calls

  Niagara domain: drivers, servlets, ORDs, topics, BQL, alarms, BOG:
    drivers                 Driver networks and their anatomy (device, extensions, managers, license)

  Security, licensing and permissions:
    license-feature         Call sites that check or read a licensed feature (checkFeature/getFeature)
    license-features        Licensed feature names with counts; --module: features a module requires

  Module audits:
    palette-lexicon-agents  Palette entries, lexicon keys (+ dup-key report), and agent registrations for a module
